WITH per AS (
  SELECT period_start_date, period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=3),
wk AS (
  SELECT f.week_ending_date, sum(f.closing_value) AS week_value
  FROM fact_stock_week f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN per ON f.week_ending_date BETWEEN per.period_start_date AND per.period_end_date
  WHERE p.category = 'Paint & Decorating' AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY f.week_ending_date)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, 'Paint & Decorating' AS category, round(avg(week_value), 2) AS average_stock_value_at_cost_eur, count(*) AS weeks FROM wk
